name: mundus-desktop
description: Mundus — desktop packaging for the Engine and GPUI components
author: Kazui

scripts.build: pnpm run build:backend && node scripts/release-preflight.mjs --platform win && pnpm run build:native:macos && pnpm run build:package-components && node scripts/build-desktop.mjs --platform win --skip-preflight
scripts.package:dir: pnpm run build:backend && node scripts/release-preflight.mjs --platform win && pnpm run build:package-components && node scripts/build-desktop.mjs --platform win --skip-preflight --package-dir
scripts.build:mac: pnpm run build:native:macos && node scripts/build-desktop.mjs --platform mac --skip-preflight
